title: Vitamin D Replacement: The Effect on Statin-Related Myalgias
brief_summary: The purpose of this project is to determine if Vitamin D supplementation \[10,000 international units of cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) by mouth weekly\] will decrease the rate of discontinuation of statin therapy due to muscle ache/pain and decrease the occurrence of muscle ache/pain due to statin therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who recently prescribed statins (in the last seven days) or who have had a recent increase in statin dose (in the last seven days)
* Patients aged 19-89 years old
* Men and women (not of childbearing potential)
* Patients receiving statins with concomitant ezetimibe

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of alcoholism or malnutrition
* receiving concomitant niacin, fibric acid derivatives, bile acid sequestrants, or other drugs that affect cholesterol levels
